## Description

Add JournalScreen opened with J, phase/effort toggle a, filter, RecordDetailScreen, and o via pager.

## Approach

1. Add JournalScreen with DataTable, open/rest separator, FilterInput (R1,R4,R6).
2. Add RecordDetailScreen for type/subject/payload/body Markdown (R5).
3. Bind J on main screen; a toggles scope; Esc returns; o reuses pager_command.
4. Cover with tests/test_dashboard_journal.py. Do not edit EffortPane kind panel.

payload.title: JournalScreen with filter, detail, and pager
